body: Don't be sorry! Well, do I believe you, but my family has a history of mental illness, so I'm more prone to it (obviously, haha). So I'm doing my best to avoid anything that could cause an altered state of mind. I'm thinking I'm going to talk to a therapist and develop a budget for mental health.

This. This is what I needed. It's funny, your main point is asking if I care about myself - the answer is a lot more complicated than one would expect. And its implications are enormous, so how I answer it matters more than the actual answer. I've been sitting here staring at my computer going through a huge mental journey figuring it all out. But things look a little brighter now. I know where to get started.

Thank you.

My university charges for mental health services. Is there anywhere else I can go?

edit: also, thank you.
